unlisted_practices: Health systems should apply the SAHAI framework to measure and mitigate the emissions, energy use, and costs of AI implementations while maintaining clinical performance and equity goals.
Health systems should consider data center efficiency, cleaner energy sources, and vendor and infrastructure choices when selecting AI solutions to reduce their environmental footprint.
Health systems should use AI responsibly to limit the environmental impact of the power consumption associated with AI technologies.
Health systems should establish explicit governance over health IT lifecycles and AI deployment that addresses sustainability.
Health systems should use energy and environmental impact transparency tools, such as EcoLogits and AI Energy Score, to quantify and compare AI models when selecting them.

screen.reason: Perspective/framework article discussing health informatics, sustainability, and AI governance for climate change mitigation in health systems.
